data.name: PrivacyPolicy
data.value: Privacy Policy

data.name: PrivacyIntro
data.value: This Privacy Policy describes how VillaHub ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our website and services.

data.name: InfoWeCollect
data.value: Information We Collect

data.name: PersonalInfo
data.value: Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, and other information you provide when registering or using our services.

data.name: UsageData
data.value: Usage Data: Information about how you use our website, including IP address, browser type, device information, and pages visited.

data.name: Cookies
data.value: Cookies: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience and analyze site usage.

data.name: HowWeUseInfo
data.value: How We Use Your Information

data.name: ProvideServices
data.value: To provide, operate, and maintain our services.

data.name: ImproveServices
data.value: To improve, personalize, and expand our website and services.

data.name: Communicate
data.value: To communicate with you, including sending updates and notifications.

data.name: ProcessTransactions
data.value: To process transactions and manage bookings.

data.name: LegalCompliance
data.value: To comply with legal obligations and protect our rights.

data.name: HowWeShareInfo
data.value: How We Share Your Information

data.name: NoSellInfo
data.value: We do not sell your personal information.

data.name: TrustedPartners
data.value: We may share information with trusted third parties who assist us in operating our website and providing services, subject to confidentiality agreements.

data.name: LegalDisclosure
data.value: We may disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights and safety.

data.name: DataSecurity
data.value: Data Security

data.name: DataSecurityDesc
data.value: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

data.name: YourRights
data.value: Your Rights

data.name: ManagePersonalInfo
data.value: You may access, update, or delete your personal information by contacting us.

data.name: OptOutMarketing
data.value: You may opt out of receiving marketing communications at any time.

data.name: ChangesPolicy
data.value: Changes to This Policy

data.name: ChangesPolicyDesc
data.value: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

data.name: ContactUs
data.value: Contact Us

data.name: ContactDesc
data.value: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact the project owner:
